policy.goal: Prefer verified trade outcomes over source count.
count_only_if: Public/free access to the actual signal, not just a market-data or news feed.
A timestamped BUY/SELL setup with symbol and timeframe.
Entry, stop-loss, TP1, TP2 and TP3 are explicitly published; never synthesize missing levels.
A source URL or original post URL is retained for audit.
Wins, losses, breakevens and unfilled signals are retained and scored consistently.
Live/open status can be distinguished from closed status and reconciled against market prices.
policy.activation_rule: Only status=verified_free_complete may be used by production trade-feed adapters. Candidates and rejected sources must never create customer trade cards.
policy.performance_rule: Do not rank by advertised win rate alone. Require sample size, net expectancy after costs, profit factor, maximum drawdown, and full loss accounting. Label provider-reported results as unverified until independently replayed.

sources.name: Borearis Markets Today

performance_evidence.caveat: Provider-reported backtest/live-quote look-back, not independently audited. Current signal layout shows one partial take-profit and one final target, not three explicit targets.

sources.activation_blocker: Do not activate until a stable public feed is confirmed and the three required target levels are genuinely published, or the product owner explicitly approves a two-target format.

sources.name: Quant Room X

performance_evidence.caveat: Provider says history is reconstructed from public Telegram posts. TP1 hit rate is not equivalent to profitable full exits; independent replay required.

sources.activation_blocker: Need reliable post-history extraction and complete explicit TP1-TP3 levels before production use.

sources.name: Forexero

performance_evidence.caveat: Public page describes closed VIP history; open signals are posted in VIP first. Not eligible as a free live source.

sources.activation_blocker: Live/open setups are not freely available on the public page.

sources.name: SignalsTrades

performance_evidence.caveat: Public page reports 38% win rate across 855 closed signals. Rejected from preferred-source shortlist pending positive net expectancy evidence.

sources.activation_blocker: Weak recent win-rate evidence; do not use as a preferred signal source.

sources.name: Quantum Algo

performance_evidence.caveat: The headline record combines public TradingView ideas with premium signals; only 43 calls are public. Do not treat the 75% aggregate as a free-feed result.

sources.activation_blocker: Free/public sample is limited and aggregate record includes paid signals.

note: These are research candidates only. No source in this file is approved for live customer trade cards yet. Candidate counts are not verified-source counts.
